We have been serving the needs of potential buyers and sellers for more than 20 years!

Our experience includes a vast range of businesses from $50,000 to over $15,000,000 in sales. Our staff of experienced professionals has the expertise to value and present your business in the best manner possible. PRIMESITE BUSINESS BROKERS Services We Offer Our commitment to service and attention to detail allows us to consistently exceed the expectations of our clients. We are proud of our extensive experience in service, distribution, manufacturing, and the retail sector. We provide a comprehensive range of services to meet the needs of each client. BUYING A BUSINESS Before making a decision to purchase a business, a buyer should understand his or her objectives to make sure those objectives can be met by purchasing any or a particular business. LEARN MORE SELLING A BUSINESS Timing is very important. Your business should be performing well and the likelihood that your customers will remain with the new business owner(s) should be good. LEARN MORE BUSINESS VALUATIONS The question asked most frequently by buyers and sellers alike is “What is this business worth?” The truth is that the process of valuing a business is rarely that simple. LEARN MORE We have registered buyers from around the world including entrepreneurs, investors, professionals and large corporations. Our unwavering commitment to service, and our attention to the highest standards of quality, have made Primesite one of the premier intermediaries in Massachusetts and the surrounding states.
